events.title: Whispers of West Grove - Demo Update
events.summary: Hello everyone,As of today, 6/02/2026, we have temporarily deactivated the demo for Whispers of West Grove as the demo is in need of a major update. A polished demo with fixes for the issues found in the previous version will be uploaded soon. I also want to thank those who have taken the time to post in our steam community regarding issues with the demo. Whether there are bugs, visual issues or game-breaking issues.
